items.title: Ukrainian Hive and Nefilim Ransomware Affiliate Gets 70 Months in US Prison
items.summary: Artem Stryzhak was sentenced to 70 months in prison after pleading guilty to using Nefilim ransomware in attacks. The post Ukrainian Hive and Nefilim Ransomware Affiliate Gets 70 Months in US Prison appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.summary_zh: Artem Stryzhak 在承認於攻擊中使用 Nefilim 勒索軟體後，被判處 70 個月有期徒刑。該文章《烏克蘭 Hive 與 Nefilim 勒索軟體加盟者遭美國法院判刑 70 個月》首次發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Even after PHP2Shell, blast radius matters more than a CVSS score
items.summary: PHP2Shell shows how quickly attackers can exploit critical vulnerabilities, often before organizations have time to patch. Token Security explains why limiting the access of service accounts, API keys, and AI agents is just as important as fixing vulnerabilities to reduce the damage from a breach. [...]
items.title_zh: 即使在 PHP2Shell 之後，爆炸半徑仍比 CVSS 分數更重要
items.summary_zh: PHP2Shell 展示了攻擊者利用重大漏洞的速度有多快，通常在企業組織來得及修補之前就已發動攻擊。Token Security 解釋了為什麼限制服務帳戶、API 金鑰和 AI 代理的存取權限，與修復漏洞一樣重要，能藉此減少入侵造成的損害。[...]
